title: Blueprints: what the game exports for every supported entity and setting, and what it makes of the blueprints this project exports
source: Recorded from the game by tools/game-probe/blueprints.mjs: LuaItemStack.import_stack, export_stack, build_blueprint and create_blueprint, and the control behaviours of the runtime API.
layout: defines: the numbers behind the defines a blueprint uses. fresh: one of every supported entity as the game places it, untouched (placed) and with its control behaviour created (withControlBehavior); the hub of a space platform, which stands nowhere else, is in the blueprints of a platform (...OnPlatform). states: entities in a state the editor does not write, a constant combinator all of whose sections were removed. defaults: per prototype with settings in the editor, what the control behaviour of a new entity says for each field of the blueprint's control_behavior (a signal that is not set is left out, and so is a network selection the prototype has no use for). directions: per prototype what becomes of each of the sixteen directions, 0 to 15 in this order: in the string of a blueprint that is given it (blueprint), on the entity the game builds from that blueprint (built), in the string of a blueprint the game makes of that entity (exported) and on an entity created with it (created); -1 where the game has no such blueprint or entity (no item builds the prototype, or it does not stand on plain ground). cases: per sample circuit of packages/blueprints/test/samples.ts the blueprint this project exported (sent), the result of LuaItemStack.import_stack (0: no errors), the game's export_stack of it right after (reexported), of the entities it built from it (rebuilt: ghosts revived, then a new blueprint; standing: entities of the blueprint that stood there before, the hub of a platform; unbuilt: prototypes the game did not build on that surface), and of the same circuit built through the runtime API without a blueprint of ours (native; helpers: what the probe built besides the circuit, a gate below every wall, which has its connection point only next to one). Every blueprint is the string and the JSON it holds.
